statement.p: Determine whether the following system has no solution, an infinite number of solutions or a unique solution.

p.m: \left\lbrace\begin{array}{rllrrr} -8 x \amp - 7 y \amp = \amp 3 \cr 4 x \amp + 4 y \amp = \amp 8 \cr -16 x \amp - 13 y \amp = \amp 25 \end{array} \right.
\left\lbrace\begin{array}{rllrrr} -8 x \amp - 7 y \amp = \amp 3 \cr 4 x \amp + 4 y \amp = \amp 8 \cr -16 x \amp - 13 y \amp = \amp 27 \end{array} \right.
\left\lbrace\begin{array}{rllrrr} 25 x \amp - 15 y \amp = \amp 10 \cr -15 x \amp + 9 y \amp = \amp -6 \cr 30 x \amp - 18 y \amp = \amp 12 \end{array} \right.
